Session date: 6:21 pm on 22 July, 2023
[D25:1] John: Hi Maria! It's so good to talk again. A lot has changed since last time. I'm really enjoying my new job. My team has been super encouraging and inspiring.
[D25:2] Maria: Hey John, glad work is going well! Having a good team is so important. I had a great experience last weekend hiking with my church  friends - it was great to be surrounded by supportive people and to enjoy nature. Felt so refreshing!
[D25:3] John: Sounds like you had a great time! What inspired you to go on the hike?
[...]
[D25:20] Maria: Cheers, John! I'll let you know. I'm off to bake some cakes. Talk to you soon!
Session date: 1:59 pm on 31 July, 2023
[D26:1] Maria: Hey John, I'm doing ok - hope you are too. Some interesting stuff has been going on; last week I dropped off that stuff I baked at the homeless shelter. It was great and I'm more motivated than ever to help people.
[D26:2] John: Hey Maria, that's awesome! I'm really inspired by your drive to make a difference. You mentioned your work at the homeless shelter last time and it made me think of how I could help too, so I just joined a fire-fighting brigade. It's such a great feeling to do something to give back to my community!
[...]
[D26:5] Maria: Wow, John! What was it like being part of that rescue mission?
[D26:6] John: It was chaotic when we arrived, but we pulled together. I got a surge of energy and purpose, and we were able to save a family from a burning building. It was wild, but knowing we made a difference made it worth it.
[D26:7] Maria: Wow John, that's intense! Helping out like that takes guts - it's inspiring to hear about the difference you made.

Session date: 3:14 pm on 13 August, 2023
[D31:9] John: They're doing great - there's been a real improvement in their confidence and skills. It was so amazing to see one of them last week, so excited to show me their essay. It was a proud moment! How's your new pup doing, Maria?
[D31:10] Maria: Awesome, John! Sounds like it's really making a difference. The little one is doing great - learning commands and house training.
[D31:11] John: Wow, cool Maria! Your little one is so smart and keen to learn, must be awesome!
[...]
[D31:16] Maria: Absolutely, John. They're always there for us.
[D31:17] John: Yeah, my family is awesome - me, the missus, and the kids. Even when times are hard, they always have my back. Best thing ever, really.
[D31:18] Maria: That picture is so cute! What activities do you all enjoy doing together?
[D31:19] John: Thanks, Maria! We love being outdoors - going for hikes, hanging out at the park, having picnics - plus playing board games and having movie nights at home. 
[D31:20] Maria: Sounds like a blast, John! Spending time with family is so important, and that all sounds perfect. Have a great time!
[D31:21] John: Thanks, Maria! I'm off to spend some time with them now. Have a good day!
[D31:22] Maria: Enjoy your family time, John! Have a great day!
[D31:23] John: Thanks, Maria! You too! Stay safe!
[...]
Session date: 11:08 am on 16 August, 2023
[D32:9] John: You're right, Maria. It's great to help out and see everyone coming together for this cause. It gives me a sense of purpose and passion. I feel like this is my true calling.
[D32:10] Maria: Awesome, John! Loving your newfound passion. You're doing great things - keep it up! It's wonderful to see everyone coming together for this cause.
[D32:11] John: Thanks, Maria! Your support means a lot to me. It's amazing how finding my passion has made such a big impact. I'll keep working hard on it. The donations even helped get a brand new fire truck!

Session date: 6:03 pm on 6 March, 2023
[D8:2] John: So sorry to hear about your loss, Maria. I'm here for you if you need anything. I'm doing well, I just had a picnic with the wife and kids.
[D8:3] Maria: Thanks for your support, John. How's your family doing? That baby in the pic is adorable! What's their name?
[D8:4] John: Thanks, Maria! They're doing great. Our one-year-old is so cute, his name is Kyle!
[...]
[D8:9] Maria: Looks like a blast! Did everyone get a chance to try it? Glad you're all having a great time!
[D8:10] John: Yeah, everyone got a chance to swing. It's always fun coming up with activities for my family to enjoy.
[D8:11] Maria: Wow, John, that's amazing! How do you come up with these ideas?
[D8:12] John: I just try to find things that we'll have fun with, like a walk or picnic in the park, or finding events in our town and beyond. Just last week, I found a violin concert that we all enjoyed. It's all about making memories together.
[D8:13] Maria: Wow, John, that's great! Making memories together is so valuable. I loved doing something similar with my siblings when I was young - it's amazing how something so simple can make such lasting memories.
[D8:14] John: That pic is so cool! It looks like something from a storybook. What gave you the idea for this?
[...]
[D8:19] Maria: Wow, that's really cool! Have you discussed it with anyone yet?
[D8:20] John: Yeah, I chatted with my family and friends about it. They've been supportive and understand why I want to volunteer. I'm really proud to have this opportunity!
[D8:21] Maria: Glad you have a good support system, John. It's been great having people behind me while volunteering at the homeless shelter. Positive influences make a big impact.

Session date: 6:10 pm on 22 December, 2022
[D2:15] Maria: Wow, John, that playground looks cool! What kind of stuff do you and your family do there?
[D2:16] John: Thanks, Maria! We love climbing, sliding, and playing games. It's an awesome way to connect and have a blast. What do you enjoy doing with your family?
[D2:17] Maria: My fam's small, but I love spending time with the friends I have. We usually watch movies, hike, and have game nights at my place. Quality connections matter most to me.
[...]
[D2:19] Maria: Definitely, John. They bring us joy, support, and a feeling of being part of something special. We should cherish every moment with them.
[D2:20] John: Yeah Maria, making memories with family is priceless! Life is so much more meaningful when we spend time together. Here's a pic of us at dinner.
[D2:21] Maria: Woah, that's a nice pic, John! You all obviously had a blast at dinner. Nothing beats getting together with loved ones for a good meal - it makes some awesome memories!
[...]
[D2:23] Maria: Yeah, John! It definitely builds a strong bond. Those shared meals really make life enjoyable and meaningful. What did you make?
[D2:24] John: We made pizza! We had so much fun making them together. It was great picking out toppings and sharing a tasty meal with family. Have you made anything lately?
[D2:25] Maria: I can picture you all laughing and having a blast making your own pizzas - a great way to bond! I made some peach cobbler recently, it was great.

Session date: 7:20 pm on 16 June, 2023

Do you have any special beach memories you'd like to share?

Session date: 12:21 am on 27 June, 2023
[D20:4] John: That's great, Maria! It's such a blessing to have family who always supports us and reminds us that we're not alone. They know us like no one else and stick by us no matter what. [D20:12] John: It's great knowing that our actions can brighten someone else's life. Keep it up!
[D20:13] Maria: Thanks, John! Gonna continue doing it - it's my way of spreading kindness and positivity.
[D20:14] John: Maria, that's great! Your way of passing on kindness and positivity is making a big impact on the world. You're really making a difference.
[D20:15] Maria: Thanks, John! Your words really mean a lot. It's always nice to know that what I'm doing is making an impact.
[D20:16] John: You definitely are. Keep going with it!
